description: Returns one property by DealMachine property ID (id, required), with its owners and their names, phones and emails by default. `contact_audience=none` returns property-only data. Needs a connected DealMachine account with paid access. Enriched data costs one property credit unless `enrich=false`; owner contacts cost people credits.

contact_audience.description: default: owners; use none for property-only data with zero people credits

name: dealmachine_property_get
